hooks.name: DepLatch: check packages before install
hooks.description: Before the agent runs any shell command, block installs of packages that do not exist or look like impostors.

hooks.name: Run tests when DepLatch code changes
hooks.description: Re-run the Node test suite whenever the agent saves a source file.

hooks.name: Keep the Python port in sync
hooks.description: When the agent changes Node logic, remind it to mirror the change in Python (tech.md: two implementations, one behaviour) and regenerate the ESM files.

action.prompt: You just changed core DepLatch logic in packages/npm. Do three things in order: (1) run `node scripts/gen-esm.js` to regenerate web/lib/*.esm.js from the updated sources, (2) make the same logic change in packages/pypi/src/deplatch/core.py, (3) run both test suites (`npm test --prefix packages/npm` and the Python suite). Verdicts, reason codes, messages and exit codes must stay identical across all three.
